steps.content: [Black Screen]
The girl has never left the dark.
All sense of direction dissolves. Time loses its shape. Only the contamination remains real, accumulating, spreading, its pain a scalpel cutting through the haze.
Where am I now? Still in the ruins of the catastrophe tear... or have I made it back to Fraser?
She hazily recalls following someone back, but her sight holds only flickering shadows and phantom shapes.

steps.speaker: Fraser Senator
steps.content: Hypatia Campbell. For you to appear now, in this state... is most regrettable.

steps.speaker: Fraser Noble
steps.content: Disgraceful wretch... You betrayed the Society, defected to DisCity, and now you betray your city-state and your blood once more...

steps.speaker: Fraser Senator
steps.content: You conspired with DisCity, leaked our Aurum Secretum technology, and caused the Ash Campaign to collapse at its most crucial hour. Then you fled to WhiteSands rather than face judgment.

steps.speaker: Fraser Noble
steps.content: What would your family think? How would your honorable brother regard you? Where is your sense of responsibility?!

steps.speaker: Fraser Senator
steps.content: You have betrayed your lineage and your city-state. You are no longer worthy of the name Campbell!

steps.speaker: Fraser Noble
steps.content: Cease this! Do you intend to shatter a century of your family's honor with your own hands?!!
The surrounding phantoms roar, charging, and pass straight through her.
Familiar accusations. Her mind and body had long grown numb to them.
She does not let them slow her steps.

steps.speaker: Boy
steps.content: I see the blue shiny rock in her hands! Is that the treasure Mom told me about?

steps.speaker: Boy
steps.content: Does that mean we won't have to keep moving all the time?

steps.speaker: Farlander
steps.content: That's a Hypercube. Yes, we won't have to wander anymore... And, don't be so rude...

steps.speaker: Farlander
steps.content: She is a lady of noble birth. A brilliant scholar... She is our savior...
They all reach out their hands toward Hypatia.
Hypatia! Hypatia!
They chant her name.

steps.speaker: Farlander
steps.content: ...Are you alright? Your wounds...
They try to help her.
Or perhaps, they are simply watching her.
Under their hopeful gazes, Hypatia finally sees the treasure in her hands.
On the "worthless" tokens from the Furorians, faint blue crystal fragments have begun to form.
...A gift from an unshakeable past.
If I can bring these out, the farlands will be saved... Everything will get better...
Then... can someone like her, wandering in hell, finally be redeemed?

steps.speaker: Yokna
steps.content: What choice do we have? Fraser and DisCity both look down on us, but we have to pick one... Which side do we go with?!

steps.speaker: Rael
steps.content: I don't give a damn about Hypercubes! Aurum Secretum Warriors and DisCity are sworn enemies. Those DisCity mutts... I'll kill every last one of 'em!

steps.speaker: Jabara
steps.content: Who cares if it's Nirvana or Fraser? Money's money, and business is business!

steps.speaker: Helga
steps.content: You think a Hypercube mine fixes everything? Do you even know what the farlands really lack? What we actually want?
[Enter Flashback Filter] (Hypatia is still in the hallucination world; consider overlaying WhiteSands background on top of the hallucination effect)
The WhiteSands motorcycle roared across the pale dunes. Helga had the wounded girl secured behind her as she raced toward Fraser.
That peace dove's intelligence is solid. If we move now, we can still make it to the opening ceremony. Whatever you're planning, I'll be there to see it.
The wind screamed past them. As they rode, Helga answered the question the girl had asked when she was pulled from the ruins.

steps.speaker: Helga
steps.content: If you want to know what the farlands are really like...

steps.speaker: Helga
steps.content: The people here have never had a future.

steps.speaker: Helga
steps.content: We're used to living under someone else's shadow, following someone else's lead. When the metropoles stood, we obeyed them. After the great city-states fell, we answered to Fraser. We even tried DisCity once, but they never looked our way twice.

steps.speaker: Helga
steps.content: I've often wondered myself... where is the future for people like us?

steps.speaker: Helga
steps.content: Someone suggested an alliance, and against all odds, we built one. I knew nothing about politics or diplomacy, but I thought I could learn. And before I knew it, I became their leader.

steps.speaker: Helga
steps.content: Once I was a leader, I saw the hard truth: we thought we had choices, but we never did. We don't have DisCity's Hypercubes or Fraser's wealth. When catastrophe hits, all we can do is... wait to die... or pray the mighty feel generous enough to help.

steps.speaker: Helga
steps.content: If any major city-state so much as glances our way, we act like it's the highest honor. We'd walk through fire for them. Jump into hell without a second thought.

steps.speaker: Helga
steps.content: In this world, "being worth exploiting" became our best bargaining chip. "Switching sides" turned into a fine art.

steps.speaker: Helga
steps.content: You're not like us...
[Back to Illusion]

You are a Fraser noble, the distinguished Lady Campbell. You are a brilliant researcher at the Luminaris Society. You have a safe, comfortable life. You never should have been dragged into life-or-death matters like ours.
Child, if you've been helping us out of guilt, that's already enough.
—You don't need to stay here.
—You don't belong here.
—You are not like us.
...No. That's not true... Ms. Helga... <color=#fb9259>There is no difference between us</color>.
In that moment, a sliver of light pierces the endless dark. Hypatia finally sees the way forward.
Past the countless illusions that have clouded her sight, she can just discern a narrow, rugged path ahead.

steps.speaker: Farlander
steps.content: What choice do we have? Who can give us an answer?

steps.speaker: Furorian
steps.content: Thank you... these are all we can give... we hope... they'll reach the hands of our loved ones.

steps.speaker: Fraser Noble
steps.content: How dare you side with those wretches from the farlands, Campbell! Are you going to betray your own city-state, your own social class?!
Many obstacles remain ahead, and many blessings, but the Hypercube in her hands gives her the strength to push forward at any cost, and the resolve to complete her mission.
And so, she begins to run through the illusion.
The pain in her neck sharpens, as if urging her onward.
Go. Hurry. Run!
With every step, determination swells, and courage forges her path.
And so, she moves through the crowds in reality and the illusions in her heart.
[Scene Transition - Sky Tower]
At the end of the path, someone stands with a smile, arms opened wide to welcome her.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: Welcome back, Hypatia.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: You've achieved a miracle. I always knew... you could.
...It's a warm, comforting embrace, and for a moment her pain seems to dissolve. The weight she's carried feels, at last, like something she can release.

It has always been this way. In her darkest hours, it was Margaret who maneuvered, negotiated, and pulled her from the brink. It was Margaret who took her hand and said, "Trust me. Follow me," offering a path when she had none.
That embrace is always warm, a calm in the storm, a source of strength when everything else feels painfully uncertain.
So now, it is time to do what must be done.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Ms. Margaret...
The girl holds her mentor tightly. Her slender arms wrap gently as she leans close, her voice a soft whisper against Margaret's ear.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: This was your plan all along, wasn't it?

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: From the moment you first approached me... you had it all planned.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: You intended to use me to push the Farland Alliance away from Fraser and into DisCity's hands. Am I right?
The cheers of the farlanders swell around them, but in the small, private space between their bodies, the noise falls away, leaving a stillness that flows like water.
The girl retrieves the broken Aurum Secretum bird from within her garments, swiftly disassembling it to expose the hidden surveillance module.
After a moment of silence, DisCity's Peace Ambassador tightens her grip on her fan and speaks, her voice soft and deliberate.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: Isn't this outcome for the best?

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: Look at their lost faces. Consider what they need... what they truly want.
Her gaze shifts to the crowd around them, their cheers ringing like the fervent hymns of worshippers witnessing a divine miracle.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: Hypatia, I have my stance, yes. But I promise they will never bring harm to you.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: You... do trust me, don't you?
Hypatia releases her hand and takes a small step back. She gazes at Margaret, at the person who has guided her and remade her.

She is such a gentle, radiant, and approachable soul. She can be temperamental, but more often she speaks with a passion for peace that ignites hope in others. It isn't a power or a performance. Hypatia knows this is Margaret's true heart.
Now, the sadness and confusion in her eyes are equally true. So are her attempts to persuade, to guide. She used Hypatia, yes, but she also cared for her, truly looked after her.
That is who Ms. Margaret is. No matter the time, the circumstance... whatever means she must employ... she will never abandon her purpose.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Thank you... for reaching across the divide between our city-states, for your steadfast and sincere pursuit of peace, for showing us a new way when all paths seemed closed.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: To someone as weak and stubborn as I am... you kept offering your hand, guiding me earnestly, again and again.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: When I was at my most lost, you were the one who guided me out of the fog. For that... I will always be grateful.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: But the road ahead is one I must walk myself. Please... let me choose my own path now.
The Hypercube in her arms emits a soft glow, lighting her eyes with a newfound determination—a resolve no one has ever seen in her before.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: So... where will you go?
She asks softly, as if already knowing there's no turning back.
Having rejected guidance, where does your path lead now?
Hypatia doesn't answer. Instead, she steps past the Peace Ambassador of DisCity and onto the nearby podium.
A calm settles over her as her fingers close around the microphone. In that moment, every recent hardship flashes before her eyes.
(microphone screeches) ——————

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: People of the farlands... I am Hypatia.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: This... is the Hypercube I retrieved from deep within the catastrophe tear. I am sorry that on my own, I could only bring back this small amount.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Along the way, I have heard your hopes. I have seen the future you dream of: a true mine at BR-005, a chance for strength, clarity, and even freedom...

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: I know the answer you are waiting to hear from me.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: I am sorry... but I cannot give you that certainty.
The crowd slowly quiets. They watch Hypatia, their expressions shifting from celebration to uncertainty, staring at the girl they had just hailed as the farlands' savior.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: ...I come from the Campbell family, a Fraser noble sheltered from hardship. I was sent to conduct Aurum Secretum research in Furor, yet I failed to protect the Furorians who aided me. I failed to prevent the cruel schemes. I failed to save the lives lost at BR-005.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: I have always been weak, too often blinded when clarity mattered most, unable to make the right choice until it was too late—forced to watch tragedy unfold before me.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Even in Aurum Secretum research, the one thing I excel at... I have no control over how it is used. It may become scars on the bodies of Aurum Secretum Warriors, or weapons turned against others.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Even now, after risking everything to enter the heart of the tear... I only returned with this tiny fragment. I cannot promise to find more. I cannot promise to free the Alliance from outside influence. I cannot promise to sustain the farlands through every storm ahead.
Hypatia's voice wavers with nerves, but she clenches her fists and draws a steadying breath, reclaiming her control.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: But...

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Of all my failures, what I regret most is my fear of standing alone, my need to depend on others, and how easily I let myself be swayed...

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Because the road ahead seemed too frightening, too bleak, I doubted my own strength. I feared choosing for myself, I desperately sought guidance, and I clung to those who appeared surer of the way... only to be led astray.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Fraser or DisCity, who is truly sincere? Whose path is right? I do not know. I cannot answer that... and perhaps neither can they.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: This is where reality differs from scientific research. Every truth in this world is clouded by agendas and interests. There is no pure, reliable answer.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Often, we are not so fortunate. We must walk alone, groping through the dark.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Yet... I still choose to go on. Because there are people I want to protect. Things I will not abandon...

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: My homeland, my convictions, the love I hold, the trust placed in me, hope... Though I am not yet strong enough, I still wish to use what little knowledge I have to guard them.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Even without a guiding light, I will still measure the path ahead with my own steps.
A ripple of unease moves through the hall, and confused murmurs begin to rise from the crowd.
Are you leaving us, Ms. Campbell?
On our own, without the backing of any big city-state... we won't make it... Even if we get Hypercubes, someone'll just take them, and we'll be left divided again.
Isn't DisCity's Peace Ambassador pretty kind to us? Why can't DisCity help us?

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Please keep watching me, Ms. Margaret. Thank you for lighting the way for someone like me, for guiding me to where I stand now...

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: I will not let you down on the road ahead.
The girl draws a deep breath, unclasps the Campbell family crest from her chest, and hurls it from the top of the Gold Palace.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: I am not the daughter of Campbell, nor am I the savior of the farlands.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: I am just Hypatia, an Aurum Secretum researcher.
I'm just like everyone here. An ordinary, vulnerable human being.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: I cannot lead anyone... Even my utmost effort can only yield something as small as... these formless Hypercube fragments.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: But I will keep moving forward. From now on, I will seek out more hope, bear every hardship, and protect our homeland in my own way.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: ...I will survive on this land.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Perhaps we are not without resources after all. Because... for those of us who have endured on these lands of famine for so long, stubbornness is our most enduring strength.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: And this homeland we cling to so stubbornly... is no dead-end crevice. Look up, you'll see how vast it truly is.
She pauses briefly.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: ...Even after saying all this, standing alone still feels uncertain. Would you... walk this road forward with me?
At first, the crowd falls into utter silence. Then, a new sound rises, not cheers or pleas, but scattered voices slowly merging into a chorus... of steady, determined commitment.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Then let us begin our journey.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: From this day on, my Aurum Secretum research belongs to the people of the farlands. Together, we will survive on these lands of famine.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: On the path ahead, we will not be alone. The Hypercubes scattered across our homeland are blessings from our loved ones who departed first. They will watch over us as we go forward.
Amid the cheers, Margaret quietly lowers her fan.
The Farland Alliance has found its new leader. As an Outland Affairs Officer, the priority now is to befriend, not make another enemy.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: Walk forward, Hypatia...
This is your first step, taken entirely on your own.
